{{Quote|I don't see why the source should matter to anyone, Admiral. As long as they show the traditional SoroSuub quality.|[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Vilim Disra|Disra]] to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]]|<ref name="Specter of the Past">''[[Specter of the Past]]''</ref>}}
The '''SoroSuub''' (sometimes also rendered as '''Soro Suub''') '''Corporation''' was a massive [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] corporation that specialized in mineral processing, but due to its ancient and wide success, it also became an industrial giant that produced a vast array of [[:Category:SoroSuub Corporation products|technological goods]], even including the capability to produce larger ships like the [[Dauntless-class heavy cruiser|''Dauntless''-class heavy cruiser]], after their many years producing the highest quality Luxury Yachts, such as the [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|Personal Luxury Yacht 3000]] and [[Peregrine-class star yacht|''Peregrine-class Star Yacht'']].

==Description==
The main activity of the SoroSuub Corporation was [[Mineral/Legends|mineral]] processing. However, the company had numerous divisions and subdivisions that handled everything from energy mining to food packaging. The technology divisions developed and produced weapons, [[Droid/Legends|droids]], communication devices, vehicles, and [[Starship/Legends|starships]].<ref name="TNEGtWaT" /> The company owned many facilities on Sullust surface as well as the [[Sullustan Orbital Shipyards]].<ref name="SoR" />

Based on [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], SoroSuub employed about half the population of the planet,<ref name="HNN46" /> and ninety percent of Sullust's workforce.<ref name="SoR" /> The company was led by a [[Chief Executive Officer/Legends|Chief Executive Officer]].<ref name="HNN46" />

[[File:SoroSuub_facility.png|thumb|270px|Outside view of one of SoroSuub's [[SoroSuub Facility|manufacturing facilities]] on Sullust.]]

Potential employees were trained at the [[SoroSuub Business Academy]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]], before being allowed into the company.

==History==
===Old Republic era===
The SoroSuub Corporation was a staggeringly ancient company. It existed as long as Sullustans had interstellar travel, dating it at over [[5500 BBY/Legends|5500 years]] old by the fall of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], which is the year recorded for when Sullust first connected to the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] and subsequently joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]]. SoroSuub had always had a great part in Sullust's economy and government and its power increased during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era, with a particular role in the planet's diplomacy.<ref name="GatORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

By the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], SoroSuub had a strong presence in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].<ref name="LFCG" /> Their security was lax enough so that [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Karae Nalvas]] stole one ship prototype from their facilities; but an independent party returned it during the [[Festival]] of [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]].<ref name="itsc">{{LivingForce|Clouds of Genarius: Into the Storm Clouds}}</ref> During [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|that same party]], SoroSuub's representative [[Miim Te'Suub]] annual speech was disturbed by an overimposed logo of another business organization, the [[Metatheran Cartel]]. Disgruntled, Te'Suub held a heated debate with Cartel's representative [[Thurm Loogg]], with the mediation of diplomats and [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] consuls. Later, after some independent pilots avoided a disaster in [[Tolea Biqua]], SoroSuub gifted one of them with the ''[[Sivulliq]]'', a SoroSuub [[RK-720 Light Freighter]].<ref name="BW">''[[Blown Away]]'' (as described in {{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20010927b_transmissions&c=swlfc|text=Transmissions From the Living Force Campaign}})</ref>

During the last days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], SoroSuub strongly dominated and influenced the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]], which later supported the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[Beolars Bribbs/Legends|Beolars Bribbs]] was CEO at that time, as well as President of the [[Sullustan Council]].<ref name="HNN46" /> During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], SoroSuub had ostensibly more power than the Sullustan Council.<ref name="GatORW" /> When Sullust eventually joined the Confederacy of Independent Systems, the Republic responded [[Battle of Sullust (Republic traitor)|invading]] the planet in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. The SoroSuub Corporation was forced to replace its CEO Beolars Bribbs with [[Siin Suub]], a Republic supporter.<ref name="SoR" />

===Imperial period===
{{Quote|SoroSuub is part of the reason I left Sullust. They were wrong to support the Confederacy during the Clone Wars, and they're wrong to support the Empire now. But most Sullustans know better. Things will change.|[[Zenn Bien]]|<ref name="Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>}}
During the early days of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], SoroSuub allied itself with the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to protect its holdings, in spite of the the protests of the population.<ref name="TNEGtVaV" />

In the years following the reorganization of the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] and the creation of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], the SoroSuub Corporation managed to become a [[contributing sponsor]] of the Authority. Contributing sponsors invested less than [[voting sponsor]]s and were not guaranteed a voting position on the CSA [[Executive Directorship Board]] but the return of investment was so huge that numerous major companies tried to enter the Authority.<ref name="HSCS" />

SoroSuub eventually took control of the planetary government. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], Siin Suub promulgated the [[Corporate Proclamation 137d]], which disbanded the [[Sullustan Council]].<ref name="SoR" /> The company became a strong supporter of the Empire, leading to an increase of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] sympathizers among the population.<ref name="GatORW" /> SoroSuub soon created the [[Sullustan Home Guard/Legends|Sullustan Home Guard]], initially to protect the company's and Imperial interests in the system, but later to fight [[Sian Tevv/Legends|Sian Tevv's]] [[Sullustan Resistance]].<ref name="SoR" />

In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Sian Tevv became SoroSuub's CEO but was forced to keep secret his Rebel allegiance.<ref name="SoR" /> Due to Sullustan objections, the Alliance, aided by [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]], staged a coup of the company. SoroSuub eventually sided with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], providing [[Dauntless-class heavy cruiser|Dauntless Cruisers]] to the Alliance, and later restored the Sullustan Council. SoroSuub remained a major producer well into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] era.
